scripts.lint:links: git ls-files "**/*.md" | grep -v '^node_modules/' | grep -v '^.git/' | grep -v '^python/.venv/' | xargs -n1 -P4 npx --yes markdown-link-check@3.12.2 -q -c .markdown-link-check.json
scripts.lint:docs: npm run -s lint:md && npm run -s lint:links
scripts.test:shell: npm run -s test:shell:total && npm run -s test:shell:certs
